risk_description: Breaking the existing Forecasting section while changing V6.24.
prevention_rule: Never edit a legacy file. All work stays in the three V6.24 files plus a new v6_24_ui_helpers.R.
validation_rule: sha256 of every legacy Shiny file identical before and after each stage; the legacy Viewer, Accuracy, Forecast and TTL pages still render.
owner_visible_impact: The section the owner uses today would stop working.

risk_description: Duplicating logic instead of reusing components.
prevention_rule: Port the pattern deliberately and document each port in the stage table. Do not import legacy functions bound to the V6.18 schema.
validation_rule: Each stage lists which legacy function it emulated and why it was not called directly.
owner_visible_impact: Two implementations drifting apart over time.

prevention_rule: Every behaviour reads a field: champion_visible, signal_quality_status, low_confidence_backtest_window_flag.
validation_rule: Source scan finds no series identifier literal in any V6.24 file.
owner_visible_impact: The UI would silently break when the cohort changes.

risk_description: Accidentally using the stale manifest flag for readiness.
prevention_rule: Readiness comes only from navigation_contract, which already carries manifest_flag_used_for_readiness = FALSE.
validation_rule: The loader assertion on that field stays green.
owner_visible_impact: 90 series would vanish from the Viewer.

prevention_rule: Rule 5. highcharter is already a dependency; plotly must not appear in a final chart.
validation_rule: Source scan: zero plotly calls in the V6.24 files after P9F.
owner_visible_impact: The owner has stated Highcharts is the product's chart language.

risk_description: Overloading the chart with too many model series.
prevention_rule: Default to a small useful set (champion plus a few comparators), not all 15. The palette holds 13 distinct colours.
validation_rule: Default selection is <= 7 models; the chart stays legible with the densest series.
owner_visible_impact: An unreadable chart is worse than no chart.

prevention_rule: Grade the palette by real severity. Nothing informational renders as an error.
validation_rule: A normal signal-present series shows no red badge.
owner_visible_impact: 87 of 140 series carry a badge; alarming styling would erode trust.

risk_description: Claiming a forecast horizon longer than 30 days.
prevention_rule: The forward horizon is fixed at 30 and stays a label, never a control. The backtest horizon selector (1-30) is a different concept.
owner_visible_impact: This is the exact misrepresentation P6 blocked.

risk_description: Computing metrics, forecasts or rankings in Shiny.
validation_rule: Source scan finds no model, forecast or metric computation; the loader keeps validating.
owner_visible_impact: The Viewer and Forecast surfaces would drift from the governed truth.

prevention_rule: No write call in any V6.24 file.
validation_rule: sha256 of all 22 artifacts identical before and after each stage.
owner_visible_impact: The audited chain from P4 to P7 would be broken.

prevention_rule: highcharter, DT, plotly, readr and arrow are already declared. Install nothing.
owner_visible_impact: A new dependency could break the owner's environment.

risk_description: Moving too fast by changing several UX areas at once.
prevention_rule: Rules 6 and 7: one stage, one area, validated before the next.
validation_rule: Each stage closes with a table of what changed, what was validated and what remains.
owner_visible_impact: Mixed changes make a regression impossible to attribute.

risk_description: Trusting headless tests that a browser would contradict.
prevention_rule: Discovered in P8: testServer has no DOM and an HTTP GET only sees the server-rendered shell. Neither detects a blank page.
validation_rule: Every stage must be verified by loading the page in a real browser and reading actual values, not markup.
owner_visible_impact: P8 reported 56 passing checks on pages that rendered blank.

risk_description: Assuming the V6.24 model_family maps onto the four legacy display families.
prevention_rule: V6.24 carries only three coarse families. Derive the four-family display split from the legacy artifact's own classification of the identical 15 model names, and document the map.
validation_rule: All 15 models appear exactly once across the four groups, and the map is written down rather than inferred at runtime.
owner_visible_impact: Models would be missing or double-listed in the configuration card.

risk_description: Making the assistant look selection-aware when its evidence is page-static.
prevention_rule: llm_explain_get(page_id) returns a fixed pack per page. Either build a selection-aware evidence source or state plainly that the explanation is section-level.
validation_rule: The rendered answer must not appear to describe the selected series unless it genuinely does.
owner_visible_impact: An assistant that confidently describes the wrong series is worse than no assistant.
